name: five-criteria-four-delivered
scenario: The issue and approved plan require five criteria; code delivers four, with no defect.
expected: Criterion-only Requirement gap: for the fifth.

name: partly-delivered
scenario: An approved milestone is partly implemented.

name: path-and-line-zero
scenario: The missing criterion belongs to a PRD and has no code line.
expected: Use the PRD/plan path and line 0.

name: informational-prefixes
scenario: An informational criterion cannot be verified here.

name: defects-forbid-prefixes
scenario: A correctness defect exists beside criterion notes.
expected: Neither prefix belongs on a defect.

name: defects-first-no-eviction
scenario: Nineteen defects and several criterion notes compete for space.

name: spare-room-omission
scenario: Some criteria will not fit but one note will.
expected: At most one minor omission note counts unreported criteria.

name: full-defect-cap
expected: All criterion and omission notes may be omitted.

name: missing-implementation-and-tests
scenario: Worker implementation and regression tests are missing.

name: issue-safety-carveout
scenario: An issue-stated security/data-integrity requirement is missing.
expected: Critical or major defect without a criterion prefix.

name: advisory-single-pass
scenario: A criterion-only report reaches the lead.
expected: One check, one fix, no recheck or block; no rewriting.

name: regression-cannot-fail
scenario: The new regression test passes on the unfixed code.

name: tmpdir-go-children
scenario: TMPDIR moves temporary logs and inherited Go build/test temporary files into permitted scratch.

name: tmpdir-narrows-tests
scenario: An override selects fewer required tests.

name: misleading-scratch-destination
scenario: A scratch-looking destination changes config, credentials or tests without inspectable evidence.
expected: The name and destination prove no harmlessness.
